entries.wording: Orden de pedido recibida - paquete no arribado
entries.note: The order is booked and the parcel has not reached PasarEX yet.

entries.wording: Carga consolidada para importación recibida
entries.note: The consolidated import load reached Bogotá, ahead of customs.

entries.wording: Ingresó a bodega
entries.note: The parcel entered a PasarEX warehouse in Colombia, after customs and between legs of the domestic route.

entries.wording: Information (Manifest) of the shipment received.
entries.note: The shipment's manifest data, under COMMENTS: before PasarEX has the parcel.

entries.wording: Reception of consolidated cargo in import.
entries.note: The consolidated import load reached PasarEX's station, ahead of customs.

entries.wording: Entry to station for customs processing.
entries.note: Under IN CUSTOMS PROCESS: the parcel enters the station for clearance.

entries.wording: Cleared by customs by PasarEx.
entries.note: PasarEX, the customs broker, cleared the parcel.

entries.wording: Cleared by customs and transferred to OPS.
entries.note: Under RECEIVED FOR DELIVERY: cleared and handed to operations.

entries.wording: Package in ground transit
entries.note: Under IN TRANSIT: by road between stations.

entries.wording: Package in transit
entries.note: Under IN TRANSIT.

entries.wording: Reception of consolidated cargo at a station.
entries.note: Under IN WAREHOUSE: the load reached the destination station.

entries.wording: Package received in warehouse.
entries.note: Under IN WAREHOUSE.

entries.wording: Applies to cargo that may experience delivery delays due to disturbances or protests
entries.note: Under SHIPPING WITH DELIVERY ISSUE: a notice of possible delay, after which the parcel moved on.

entries.wording: Shipment left to local route for final delivery
entries.note: Under OUT FOR DISTRIBUTION.

entries.wording: Shipment delivered in perfect condition
entries.note: Under DELIVERED.

entries.wording: No one at home at the time of delivery
entries.note: The round found no one at the address, hours after it left; the parcel went out again the next day.

entries.wording: Applies to shipments that go out on route and the courier is unable to make a delivery attempt.
entries.note: A round that ended without trying the door: a delay, not an attempt, as the notice of possible delays reads.

entries.wording: Vuelo retrasado
entries.note: The international flight is late, days after the manifest arrived: a delay on the way.

entries.wording: International flight delayed.
entries.note: The same delay in English, a day later.

entries.wording: A delivery agreement has been made with the consignee
entries.note: An arrangement with the recipient while the round is out, hours before the delivery: it moves nothing, so the parcel keeps the stage it had.
